messages.subject: uiOutput - possible bug
parts:
Hello

I noticed an interesting property of uiOutput and elements inside it.
What I noticed was that when you dynamically add an element inside a uiOutput block (say a selectInput) it's input$xxx variable has a value of NULL before it is added and gets a new value (depending then on what is selected) after it is added. However if you then dynamically remove that same element from uiOutput then it's value stays the same as it was before removal.
I would expect the value of an element inside a uiOutput block to revert back to NULL once it is removed but that doesn't happen.
As a work around I used shiny's javascript functions to force the value of my input back to NULL with Shiny.onInputChange("xxx", null);.
This seems like a thing that should happen automatically though.

I attached an example project I made to illustrate the behaviour

All the best
Taavi
